name: std::locale::operator()
intro: Compares two string arguments s1 and s2 according to the lexicographic comparison rules defined by this locale's std::collate<CharT> facet. This operator allows any locale object that has a collate facet to be used as a binary predicate in the standard algorithms (such as std::sort) and ordered containers (such as std::set).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
s1

 -

 the first string to compare


 s2

 -

 the second string to compare

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if s1 is lexicographically less than s2, false otherwise.
